crossRefs.note: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone, and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank…
Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out…

people.name: Sisera
people.line: Canaanite commander defeated by Deborah and Barak.

translations.web: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.
translations.bsb: She reached for the tent peg, her right hand for the workman’s hammer. She struck Sisera and crushed his skull; she shattered and pierced his temple.
translations.kjv: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
translations.asv: She put her hand to the tent-pin, And her right hand to the workmen's hammer; And with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote through his head; Yea, she pierced and struck through his temples.
